question: Who among the following rulers belonged to the Tuluva dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishnadeva Raya**__.

__
 
• **Krishnadeva Raya belonged to the Tuluva dynasty.​**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tuluva dynasty is the third dynasty of the Vijayanagara empire the other three are Sangama, Saluva, Aravidu dynasties.

 
 
• Krishnadevaraya was the second son of Tulva Narasa Nayaka.
 
• He ruled the largest empire after the decline of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• **Titles**: Andhra Bhoja, Kannada Rajya Rama Ramana, Dakshinasamudradhishwara.
 
• **Foriegn Travellers**: Domingo Paes, Fernao Nuniz both are from Portugese.
 
• **Note**: His reign is considered as Telugu Literature. Eight Telugu known as Ashtadigajjas were considered as pillars of his literary assembly.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simha Vishnu** is one of the kings of the Pallava Dynasty.

 
 
• ​He was the first Pallava monarch whose kingdom extended beyond Kanchipuram.
 
 
 
• ​**Vishnuvardhana** belonged to Hoysala Empire.
 
 
• ​Originally a follower of Jainism converted into Hinduism under the influence of Ramanujacharya.
 
 
 
• ​**Pushyamitra Sunga** was the founder of the Sunga Empire.
 
 
• ​​His history is recorded in Harshacharita authored by Banabhatta.
